name: Invoice PDF to Sheet (AI Extraction) v1.3

parameters.queryString: 'YOUR_INBOX_FOLDER_ID' in parents and mimeType = 'application/pdf' and trashed = false

assignments.name: extractionPrompt
assignments.value: You are an accounts-payable data extraction assistant. Extract the fields below from the attached invoice. Rules: use null for any field that is not printed on the document; never guess, infer, or calculate a missing value; copy amounts exactly as printed (numbers only, no currency symbols or commas); format dates as YYYY-MM-DD; if the due date is text such as 'Due upon receipt', set due_date to null and put that text in due_date_note.

nodes.name: OK: Logged Only

parameters.content:
## Setup (v1.3)
1. Set the Inbox folder ID on **Google Drive Trigger** and **List Inbox PDFs** (`YOUR_INBOX_FOLDER_ID`).
2. Everything else is in **Config**: Processed folder, Invoice Log sheet ID, notify/alert emails, time zone, the Gemini prompt and response schema (shared by all 3 models).
3. Sheet header row must include: Source File ID, Model Used, Due Date Note, Processed At.

Duplicates (same Drive file ID, or same vendor + invoice #) are skipped: no log, rename, move or email. Only Needs Review invoices email immediately.
